from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4eed77c3.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Uniform internal rows/columns mark the borders of equal-sized panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_divs = [r for r in range(1, h - 1) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(1, w - 1) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, tile))
    # Background is the most frequent color in panels; find the unique panel
    # containing foreground marks and use its exact pattern for every panel.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for _,_,_,_,tile in panels for row in tile for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonempty = [pnl for pnl in panels if any(v != bg for row in pnl[4] for v in row)]
    src = nonempty[0][4]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,_ in panels:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = src[dr][:]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
